g.text: Faster-BAGEL vs baseline: 4 seeds × 2,000 steps each
Official SFT recipe, eight 80 GB Hopper GPUs · training losses as 10-step means · held-out: 100 VLM rows (8,407 tokens) with images disjoint from training
Round 2 (four seeds, criterion fixed before the runs): consistent windows CE 19/20, MSE 20/20, log gradient norm 19/20, all final windows and both held-out values within δ: CONSISTENT.
Round 1 (two seeds, |E| ≤ |Y| with a two-seed yardstick) was NOT CONSISTENT and is kept as recorded. No run was repeated; all values finite.
